posts.title: New Weekly Game: "Zork I: The Great Underground Empire" from Infocom
posts.description: The classic text-based adventure! You can't get better graphics than your own imagination, so I think this is a game that may be forever relevant. I have not played it too much, but spent an hour or two in the past giving it a try. It's pretty fun to have the freedom to completely explore and interact with your environment without (strict) restrictions on your actions. Definitely would have helped
